savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: This Order shall be effective as of February 15,1981.

conclusion: EO 12292 (signed 1981-02-23, 46 FR 13967-13968) conforms existing Foreign Service orders to the Foreign Service Act of 1980: secs. 1-9 amend nine orders, sec. 10(a)-(m) revokes thirteen orders or parts of orders, sec. 11 makes the whole order effective as of 1981-02-15. It has no savings, continuation, transfer or exception clause and the revocations are unqualified. Its recital ('in order to conform existing Executive Orders to changes resulting from that Act') indicates substitution by statute but does not itself save or transfer anything. Any residual must come from the revoked order itself; the 1980 Act's transition provisions (Pub. L. 96-465) are not held and were not read.
